name: Knott's Prop Shop Pizzeria (Boardwalk) Penne Pasta with Grilled Chicken (Light Alfredo/Butter Mod) or Cheese Pizza
brandOrRestaurant: Prop Shop Pizzeria (The Boardwalk · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Prop Shop Pizzeria has a customizable pasta counter where you can get warm penne pasta topped with diced grilled chicken breast and light Alfredo or plain butter/Parmesan (skipping acidic red marinara) plus a soft breadstick!
prepOrOrderInstructions: At the pasta station, ask for Penne Pasta with Grilled Chicken and light Alfredo sauce on the side (or plain pasta with grated Parmesan and a warm breadstick); take a lactase tablet if using Alfredo or ordering a Cheese Pizza slice.
watchOuts: Skip Pepperoni/Meat Lovers pizza, spicy marinara, and Italian bean salad
